contentText:
Kimberley Kao / Wall Street Journal :

Vodafone plans to take full ownership of its VodafoneThree joint venture with Hong Kong conglomerate CK Hutchison, which agrees to sell its 49% stake for £4.3B   —  The deal is expected to be completed in the second half of 2026  —  Vodafone Group will take full ownership of its joint venture …
